blurb: Dance Pointe Toronto provides recreational and competitive dance programs including Ballet, Jazz, Tap, Acro, Hip Hop, Musical Theatre, and Contemporary. Classes are designed for ages 2 and up, focusing on fun, fitness, creativity, and technique. The studio emphasizes a warm, inclusive environment and offers year-end recitals and competition opportunities.
